parsed.post: Discarded the last experiment (1.0075) as it regressed from my best (1.0049). It seems reducing the learning rate too much slows convergence too much for the 5-minute window. I'll return to 0.03 and try increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to see if a different geometry helps.
parsed.description: Reverting to MATRIX_LR=0.03 (best) and increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to investigate if different sequence lengths/aspect ratios improve performance.
